definitions.explanation: A person who has prior experience in a particular field, activity, or situation. Frequently used in job listings and recruitment.

examples.japanese: {経験者|けいけんしゃ}⟦{優遇|ゆうぐう}→優遇：17162_yuuguu⟧。

{経験者|けいけんしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Hearing from someone with experience is the most helpful reference.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}→未経験者：26291_mikeikensha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{経験者|けいけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Even those without experience can apply for this job, but those with experience are more likely to be hired.

notes: Very common in job advertisements and recruitment. Common collocations: {経験者|けいけんしゃ}⟦{優遇|ゆうぐう}→優遇：17162_yuuguu⟧ (experienced applicants preferred — standard phrase in job ads), {経験者|けいけんしゃ}⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧ (experienced applicants welcome), {経験者|けいけんしゃ}⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧ (seeking experienced applicants). The opposite is ⟦{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}→未経験者：26291_mikeikensha⟧ (inexperienced person). The suffix ～⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person) combines productively: ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧ (beginner), ⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧ (person in charge).
